title: SHA-224 uses independent initialization
summary: SHA-224 uses the same family of compression operations as SHA-256 and a different initial hash value.
applies: Byte representation and parameter explanation of cryptography questions
detail: Trimming the hex output of SHA-256 to 56 characters usually does not result in SHA-224. Algorithm identification and truncation conventions should be checked.
boundary: The 28-byte output length may also result from other digests or explicit truncation, and the algorithm cannot be determined from the length alone.
relevance: Explains cases where records marked 224-bit and truncated by SHA-256 still fail to match.
